correctness.rationale: The exact 13-face input has 21 Hasse incidences. Complete enumeration produces 2121 nonempty simplices with face vector (21,162,560,846,468,64). The package lists 1048 disjoint valid face-poset matched pairs and 25 critical faces. Independent topological sorting confirms the entire 2121-vertex reversed Hasse graph is acyclic. Exactly one critical 0-cell and 24 critical 3-cells imply a CW complex consisting of a point with 24 trivially attached 3-cells, hence an integral wedge of 24 S3. A separate full mod-two rank calculation agrees but is not needed for the integral proof. The claim is strictly confined to this specified simplicial complex.

value.rationale: This is the unique 3-facet puncture of the tetrahedral 2-sphere and the smallest cone on a noncontractible polygonal boundary, a canonical test beyond simplices for the newly studied ordinary Morse-matching-space functor. The homotopy type shifts sharply from the published 21 S3 plus 24 S4 for the boundary to exactly 24 S3 upon deletion. Its explicit complete acyclic certificate gives a reusable benchmark for topological sensitivity to a single facet; no general theory or downstream theorem is claimed.
